name: PW Feed Store Readiness Audit
author: pwfeedtr

sections.description:
PW Feed Store Readiness Audit helps WooCommerce store owners review site readiness, product data consistency, business transparency, and common policy risks.

PW Feed Store Readiness Audit is an independent PW Feed plugin. It is not developed, endorsed, or approved by Google. Audit results do not guarantee Merchant Center approval.

Features include local WordPress and WooCommerce checks, protected public-homepage inspection, controlled 100-product batches, policy-topic preparation checks, address consistency guidance, prioritized results, locally stored score history, and printable or downloadable reports.

Automatic text and keyword checks can miss content produced by page builders, images, maps, scripts, translations, or unusual formatting. Results should always be reviewed manually. Policy-topic checks are preparation guidance and are not legal advice.

PW Merchant API is a separate optional commercial product. It is not a paid unlock or required component of PW Feed Store Readiness Audit; this plugin remains fully functional and free without it.

Global product information and PW Feed resources are available at PW Feed. Turkish-language information is available at WooCommerce plugins.

Languages

English is the source language. PW Feed Store Readiness Audit uses WordPress internationalization functions and automatically follows the WordPress administration language when a community language pack is available. It does not add a separate language selector. Translations are managed through translate.wordpress.org after publication.

External requests

PW Feed Store Readiness Audit does not contact external services automatically. When an authorized administrator explicitly starts the “another website” audit, the plugin sends a limited HTTP request from the WordPress server to the public website address entered by that administrator. The request is used only to inspect the returned public homepage HTML. No form is submitted and no account is created. The entered website may record the request in its normal server logs.

The plugin blocks private and local network targets, credentials in URLs, non-standard ports, unsafe URLs, oversized responses, and non-HTML responses. Google Merchant Center is not contacted by this feature.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin directory to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP file in WordPress.
  2. Activate PW Feed Store Readiness Audit.
  3. Open PW Store Audit from the WordPress administration menu.
